notes:
This is the first release candidate for LibreServ Luna's initial beta. 

You may refer to it as Luna Beta 0 RC 0

- chore: bump toolchains to Go 1.27.1 and Rust 1.99.0
- docs(release): drop the release plan; feed spec and tool notes live beside the code
- chore: finish the Sol rename, drop the remaining LibreServ names
- perf(release): OS slot image at xz preset 3 (2x faster, 2.8% bigger)
- perf(release): live squashfs in zstd, ISO xz at preset 0
- perf(release): write lunad's version into the finished binary instead of compiling it in
- fix(release): verify cloudflared, pin OS bases and rustup by digest/sha256, pin Gradle checksum
- feat(release): EuroOffice and draw.io packs as installer build jobs
- feat(release): Luna OS image and installer ISO parts with input-hash reuse
- feat(luna-web): show a failed system update in Settings and let an Admin try it again
- fix(lunad): record a new OS image only after luna-boot-ok confirms the boot; report and clear a failed OS update
- fix(lunad): keep slot UUID across OS updates; record OS hash only after the new slot boots
- chore(luna): CI checks and setup scripts follow the rootless ISO build
- test(luna-os): install check proves the LUNAASSETS token path
- refactor(luna-os): live system build in its own script; cache key covers it
- fix(luna-os): BIOS GRUB reads ESP/grub/grub.cfg; add QEMU install and boot checks
- fix(luna-web): copy excalidraw fonts into the real build output dir
- feat(luna-os): rootless ISO (mmdebstrap + grub-mkrescue), installer streams the .img.xz
- feat(luna-os): rootless OS image build, .img.xz compressed once, input hash
- fix(updates): say plainly when no feed is published yet
- feat(luna-desktop): check Luna's API version and update on Windows from the feed
- docs: point key and update notes at the signed feed
- feat(luna): update Luna from the signed release feed
- feat(luna-desktop): move the Flatpak to GNOME 51 and build per-channel bundles
- test(luna-web): give the lazy note editor wait headroom when the machine is busy
- …and 334 more changes
